title: AI in retail: From adoption to lasting advantage

###### 2026 EXL Enterprise AI Study | Retail # AI in retail: From adoption to lasting advantage Confidence in AI is outpacing actual performance. See what separates retailers with measurable outcomes from those stuck in place. [Read EXL’s US Enterprise AI Study Retail Summary](https://www.exlservice.com/insights/reports-research/ai-retail-adoption-lasting-advantage#exl_fullreport) 84% of retailers believe they are ahead of competitors in AI adoption 6% qualify as Leaders 86% of retail executives say their data is a challenge to AI success 96% of retailers say scaling AI is very important this year ### #### EXL surveyed executives across five industries, including retailers, to find out where AI is delivering value and where perception is running ahead of reality. This special report for retail and consumer package goods shows what is driving outcomes today and the factors separating AI leaders from the rest. **What you'll learn about AI for retailers:** 01

Where AI is already delivering measurable outcomes

02
